data.current_summary: Generate a Sudoku puzzle image at a specific difficulty
data.current_description:
Generates a Sudoku puzzle image at the requested difficulty level.
Difficulty controls the number of pre-filled clues (and thus how hard
the puzzle is to solve).

| Difficulty | Clues |
|---|---|
| beginner | 45–50 |
| easy | 38–44 |
| medium | 32–37 |
| hard | 26–31 |
| expert | 20–25 |
| extreme | 17–19 |

Valid difficulty levels: beginner (45-50 clues), easy (38-44), medium (32-37), hard (26-31), expert (20-25), extreme (17-19).
